lines.ja: そのお店 カニも出るって言われて…

lines.en: First of all, there wa— there was a ton of crab legs.
lines.ja: カニの脚が山ほど出てきてさ！

lines.en: And somebody said to me: "You need to get Biboo to open them for you!"
lines.ja: 誰かに言われたんだ 「カニを剥かせるならビブーだ！」

lines.en: "Oh okay!" And she was really... she was really really good at opening crab legs!
lines.ja: 「わかった！」ビブーは本当にカニを 剥くのがうまいから！

lines.en: "Okay! Okay okay!" And I asked Biboo,
lines.ja: 「うん！わかった！」って ビブーに頼んだら

lines.en: and she was like in a trance.
lines.ja: そこからはビブー無双

notes.meaning: 恍惚状態、夢中になっている様子

lines.en: She was so relaxed by this massage or something, and as she's being massaged,
lines.ja: リラックスした状態で 肩を揉まれながら

lines.en: she just opens like half of a crab...
lines.ja: 1人で5割ぐらい剝いてくれた

lines.en: And she was just so good at it,
she was pulling out, like you know, full pieces of meat...
lines.ja: 身を全部ひっぱり出してくれて

lines.en: She was just... It was incredible!
lines.ja: とにかく… すごかった！

lines.en: Like not saying anything, it was just complete autopilot.
lines.ja: 黙々と… 完全自動運転だった

notes.meaning: 自動操縦。何も考えずに作業をこなす様子の比喩
